conventions.convention: Interval cells are oriented left to right; minus is the left trace, plus the right trace, and the jump is plus minus minus. Endpoint outward normals are −1 and +1.
SBP volume and face norms are positive diagonal; face restrictions literally select volume nodes. Interior face nodes and weights match, with opposite outward normals.
The outward scalar speed is β·n; upwinding uses the interior trace at positive speed and the neighbor or prescribed inflow trace at negative speed.
The projection relation uses raw measurable L2 functions and polynomial orthogonality. Uniqueness requires positive measure on every nonempty relatively open cell subset.

The nonlinear interface flux subtracts α[v]/2, with α≥0 unchanged under orientation reversal. Physical boundary entropy contribution is vᵀF*−ψ and must be nonnegative; periodic pairs instead enter the interior dissipation sum.
The fully discrete update is restricted to degree-zero scalar transport on periodic matching affine simplicial meshes in dimension at least two, with each outgoing face CFL λK≤1.
The smooth-solution theorem gives a projection-trace residual estimate, not an asymptotic mesh rate. Its measure prerequisites assume Countable Choice, including in the interval branch.

load_bearing.statement: SBP compatibility requires Dℓ1=0, RF1=1F, and Qℓ+Qℓᵀ=ΣF nF,ℓ RFᵀMFRF, with positive diagonal norms and matching interior face nodes and weights.
For constant β, the differentiable broken polynomial state satisfies the elementwise weak transport equation with outward numerical flux (β·n) times the specified upwind trace.

On matching affine simplicial meshes in dimension at least two, supplied directional entropy-conservative fluxes and compatible diagonal-norm SBP data define the displayed flux-differencing residual with interface flux Σℓ nℓFℓec−α[v]/2 and nonnegative physical boundary entropy contribution.

For every finite measure μ on a bounded nondegenerate interval or nondegenerate affine simplex K that assigns positive measure to every nonempty relatively open subset, every p≥0, and every u∈L2(μ), the projection relation contains exactly one polynomial ΠKu, and ||u−ΠKu||2≤||u−w||2 for each w∈Pp(K).

On a finite periodic matching affine simplicial mesh in dimension at least two, under Countable Choice and λK≤1, the degree-zero upwind forward-Euler step conserves ΣKVKUK and does not increase ΣKVKη(UK) for every convex η:R→R.
